## Experience
### Applied AI Engineer — DIANA Student Robotics Team (Politecnico di Torino)
*Oct 2023 – Jan 2026*
- Built the computer vision pipeline for the rover's object-detection task.
- Contributed to the team's 4th place out of 126 at the European Rover Challenge (ERC) 2025.
- Collected field images of the probe, annotated them in CVAT and applied data augmentation.
- Trained a YOLOv8 probe-detection model on the annotated dataset using PyTorch.
- Built an inverse-kinematics simulation in MATLAB/Simulink for a 6-DoF arm used to collect detected probes.

## Projects
### SpaceX Launch Data Pipeline (2026)
- Repository: https://github.com/sallyze/spacex-pipeline
- Designed a 4-stage Python pipeline: collect, clean, store, display.
- Collected data from a public REST API and cleaned it with Pandas.
- Stored data on 205 launches in two PostgreSQL tables using SQLAlchemy.
- Ran the database using Docker Compose for a repeatable setup.
- Built a Streamlit dashboard showing annual launch counts and successful launches from 2006 to 2022.

### Triple DES (3DES) Encryption in Pure Python (2025)
- Repository: https://github.com/sallyze/cryptography-Triple-DES
- Implemented 3DES encryption and decryption from scratch in Python, with no external libraries.
- Implemented the S-boxes, Feistel network, and ECB mode of operation.
